public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-5 was not tantamount to AGI, although OpenAI thought or claimed that it would be.

statement.excerpt: And all this from a company thought (or claimed) that GPT-5 was going to be tantamount to AGI (spoiler alert: it wasn’t)

from_speaker: GPT-5 was going to be tantamount to AGI
our_interpretation: This contains two assertions: an earlier OpenAI expectation or claim, and GPT-5's failure to reach that level by the September 2025 quotation.
The ordinary capability reading is broad, human-level general intellectual performance, rather than success on an isolated benchmark.
Company expectations require an attributable statement or reliable evidence of internal expectations. Outside speculation alone is insufficient.
The historical interval has no specified beginning because the alleged earlier expectation is undated.
The phrase 'thought (or claimed)' is part of the historical assertion, not a conditional forecast antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes both that OpenAI expected or claimed GPT-5 would amount to AGI and that the released GPT-5 fell short under an ordinary, stated understanding of AGI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence refutes the attributed expectation or claim, or establishes that GPT-5 had reached the relevant general capability level. Failure to find an earlier statement alone is not refutation.
